G4-7 · Shared states and accessibility · one kit for every platform · for your review (not merged)

Approved direction: option A (ED-186). Each state in light and dark (final P1 map). Wording comes from the app where it exists; new wording is marked proposed. What a message promises was checked read-only against the app: changes save on the device first, an outbox holds them until the server accepts them, retries resend the same ids, conflicts are per field and keep the other device's value until you choose.

Decisions for you (nothing below is merged)
Q1 · Approve the kit's look (this board): loading, empty, errors, sync status, conflict journey, accessibility frames.
Q2 · Web storage: the browser can clear web data unless the app asks it to keep it. Recommended: ask the browser to keep storage on sign-in, and until then say "Saved in this browser". Implementation dependency, not a design change.
Q3 · Undo after resolving a conflict: the app has none. Recommended: add Undo to the toast for 10 s (it re-applies the value you replaced).
Q4 · "Keep both" for text details (title, notes): not in the app. Recommended: not now; Keep mine / Keep theirs only, revisit if people ask.
Q5 · CR-154 follow-up: the approved #6F6978 reaches 5.45:1 on most surfaces but 4.24:1 on two tinted Android Create task headers (#E8E5EE, #F0E3E5). Recommended: #6A6473 for that placeholder (4.57:1), or keep #6F6978 and lighten those headers.
Implementation, not design: CR-158 expired session during sync should say "Sign in again"; one-tap retries must reuse the same task id; device, VoiceOver, TalkBack, Reduce Transparency, Increase Contrast and offline web caching stay PENDING.
Native behaviour per platform
iPhone: system sheet and alert styles, Dynamic Type to AX5, VoiceOver rotor, Reduce Transparency swaps glass for solid (iOS 26 and the iOS 16–18 fallback alike).
Android: Material snackbar and progress, TalkBack, font scale 200 %, the custom toolbar turns solid when blur is off.
Mac: popover from the sidebar line, keyboard focus order, VoiceOver, vibrancy falls back to solid under Reduce Transparency.
Web: aria-live status, focus rings, Back/Forward and refresh keep the open sheet's URL (ED-097); offline page only before the first visit.
Tablets: inherit every state; presentations in Prompt D Round 2.

B · Sync status
One vocabulary everywhere; icon + words, never colour alone.
State (icon + words)What it promisesWhere it showsAnnounced
On this deviceSigned out. Tasks stay on this device.Sync sheet: "Sign in…"none
Synced · 4 min agoUp to date with your other devices.Header button dot; Mac/web sidebar linenone
Syncing…Sending and receiving changes. Tasks stay on screen.Header button ringnone
Offline · changes saved hereNo connection. Every change is saved on this device first.Banner + header iconpolite, once
3 changes waiting to syncSaved here; not yet on your other devices.Header badge "3"; sheet linenone
Couldn't syncYour changes are safe here; it will try again (5 s, doubling to 5 min).Header badge "!"; sheetpolite
Sync pausedThis device's clock is fast; its changes wait until the clock is right.Sheet linepolite
1 change needs youThe same detail changed on two devices; the other device's change is in use until you choose.Banner "Review" + header badgepolite
Couldn't save on this deviceThe change did not save. Try again; the draft stays open.Snackbar / toast at the editassertive
Session endedSign in again to keep syncing. Tasks stay on this device.Banner "Sign in…"polite
